title: Chính Thất Cao Tay, Tiểu Tam Trắng Tay
style: Photorealistic live-action Vietnamese family drama with a sharp comic bite, set in Hà Nội today; warm natural grade with jewel-toned silks glowing in a tailor shop, muted old-quarter ochres, glossy cold tones for the wealthy world, golden banquet light, natural skin texture, subtle 35mm film grain, shallow depth of field.
lighting: Naturalistic soft lighting: warm window light and a desk lamp over the sewing machine in the tailor shop, warm tungsten at home, cool blue-white glass light in the luxury apartment and the office, golden chandelier light at the banquet hall, soft green-gold daylight in the countryside.
voice_common: every character speaks standard Hà Nội Northern Vietnamese (never Southern or Central accents), says each word once and clearly, and sounds clearly different from the other speaker in pitch, age and texture.

@Thu.name: Thu
@Thu.anchor: Thu, 34, calm and quietly brilliant wife who runs a small áo dài tailor shop in the old quarter; slim, lightly sun-tanned, long black hair in a low loose bun, gentle watchful dark eyes, no makeup, work-roughened hands; faded light-blue cotton blouse with rolled sleeves, dark-brown trousers, dark-green cloth apron, a yellow tailor's measuring tape around her neck, plastic sandals.
@Thu.voice: woman of 34, soft low mezzo, warm and very steady, never raises her voice

@Tung.name: Tùng
@Tung.anchor: Tùng, 37, Thu's husband, newly rich construction company director; tall, slightly heavy, neatly gelled black hair, clean-shaven, heavy-lidded confident eyes; tailored charcoal-grey suit, white shirt open at the collar, gold wristwatch, polished black shoes.
@Tung.voice: man of 37, deep heavy baritone, clipped and self-important

@Vy.name: Vy
@Vy.anchor: Vy, 24, Tùng's glamorous young secretary who is secretly a con artist; slender and striking, long glossy wavy dark-brown hair, sharp feline eyes with winged eyeliner, red lipstick; fitted crimson sleeveless midi dress, thin gold necklace, beige high heels, small white handbag with no logo.
@Vy.voice: young woman of 24, high honeyed soprano with a coy lilt that can snap cold and sharp

@BaNhan.name: Bà Nhàn
@BaNhan.anchor: Bà Nhàn, 70, Tùng's sharp-witted mother who lives with Thu; small and thin, white hair in a neat low bun, kind deeply wrinkled face; brown knitted cardigan over a grey blouse, black trousers, cloth slippers, carved bamboo walking stick.
@BaNhan.voice: old woman of 70, thin raspy voice with a slight tremble and dry wit, drawn-out old Hà Nội vowels

@Na.name: Na
@Na.anchor: Na, 9, Thu and Tùng's daughter; small, round face, bright dark eyes, black hair in two short pigtails with red hair ties; white short-sleeve school shirt, navy pleated skirt, red scarf knotted at the neck, white canvas shoes.
@Na.voice: girl of 9, high clear child's voice, bright and earnest

@Khai.name: Khải
@Khai.anchor: Khải, 30, Vy's secret husband who poses as her lawyer cousin; lean, styled black undercut hair, thin moustache, sly half-smile; black slim-fit shirt with rolled sleeves, beige chinos, white sneakers, silver chain bracelet.
@Khai.voice: man of 30, smooth lazy tenor, slightly nasal, sly and drawling

scenes.title: Khách Lạ Đặt Áo Cưới
scenes.time_label: Chiều, tiệm may áo dài phố Hàng Gai (00:00–01:00)
scenes.location: Tiệm may áo dài nhỏ của Thu trên phố Hàng Gai, phố cổ Hà Nội, buổi chiều.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đặt cạnh kệ lụa nhìn ra cửa kính: bàn cắt ở giữa, máy may bên trái, gương thử đứng bên phải, cửa kính có chuông đồng ở xa nhất.
scenes.props: Thước dây vàng trên cổ Thu, cây lụa đỏ, phong bì đỏ dày, chuông đồng trên cửa, máy may cũ màu đen, phấn may.
scenes.setting: Thu's narrow áo dài tailor shop on an old-quarter silk street by day: bolts of jewel-toned silk stacked on wooden shelves to the ceiling, two headless dress forms in half-finished áo dài, an old black sewing machine on a worn wooden table, a tall standing fitting mirror, a long cutting table with tailor's chalk and paper patterns, a small brass bell above the glass door, soft daylight from the street.

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Thu này, chồng con dạo này đi họp về toàn thơm nước hoa đàn bà đấy nhé.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Đàn ông có tiền thì mũi đàn bà phải thính hơn, mẹ ạ. Mẹ lo gì.

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Thính thôi chưa đủ đâu, con phải tinh nữa cơ. Mẹ nói thế thôi đấy.

clips.sfx: the rhythmic clatter of an old treadle sewing machine, rustling silk, motorbikes passing on the street outside, a soft snip of thread

steps: @BaNhan stands at the cutting table folding a length of pale silk and is already speaking, dry and half to herself, without looking up.
@BaNhan keeps talking as she smooths the fold flat with her thin old hands.
@BaNhan raises one eyebrow toward the sewing machine as she goes on.
@BaNhan finishes the sentence and lays the folded silk on the pile.
@BaNhan closes her mouth and waits, holding her bamboo stick.
@Thu sits at the sewing machine guiding red silk under the needle and starts answering slowly in a low calm voice, eyes on the needle.
@Thu keeps speaking evenly, a faint smile at the corner of her mouth.
@Thu rocks the treadle once as she adds a short last remark.
@Thu finishes, closes her mouth and keeps sewing.
The needle stops; @Thu breathes out softly, mouth closed.
@BaNhan wags one finger toward @Thu and fires back a quick dry remark with a chuckle.
@BaNhan keeps talking briskly, eyes twinkling, while @Thu looks up at her, mouth closed.
@BaNhan finishes her last words and closes her mouth.
@BaNhan shuffles toward the narrow inner staircase with her carved bamboo stick, mouth closed.
@Thu snips the red thread with small shears and smooths the silk, alone at the machine, thoughtful and silent.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Chị là chủ tiệm ạ? Em cần may một bộ áo dài cưới, thật đẹp vào, tiền không thành vấn đề.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Em ngồi đi. Cưới ngày nào để chị xếp lịch?

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Tháng sau ạ. Chị đo kỹ cho em nhé, em kén lắm, khó chiều lắm.

clips.sfx: a brass door bell jingling, street traffic swelling then muffled as the door closes, high heels clicking on tiles, a stool scraping

85mm close-up of the customer by the silk shelves, slow push-in

40mm medium two-shot at the cutting table, slow push-in

steps: The brass bell jingles as @Vy steps in through the glass door and is already speaking, sweet and a little haughty, looking around.
@Vy keeps talking as she walks along the bolts of jewel-toned silk, heels clicking on the tiles.
@Vy runs one hand along a bolt of red silk as she goes on.
@Vy stops at the cutting table, finishing her request with a bright smile.
@Vy closes her mouth and tilts her head, waiting.
@Thu rises from the sewing machine, watching her, mouth closed.
@Thu sets down her chalk and answers politely and evenly.
@Thu pulls out a wooden stool beside the cutting table as she finishes.
@Thu closes her mouth and gestures to the stool.
@Vy sits down and starts to reply with a small private smile, as if enjoying a joke.
@Vy keeps talking while she crosses her legs.
@Vy sets her small white handbag on the cutting table, still talking.
@Vy finishes and closes her mouth, looking @Thu up and down.
@Thu picks up a pencil and an order pad, mouth closed.
@Thu holds the pencil over the pad, waiting, while @Vy smiles without a word.

clips.sfx: paper sliding across wood, the street muffled behind glass, a clock ticking on the shelf, one slow breath

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Chú rể là anh Tùng, giám đốc công ty xây dựng. Chồng của chị đấy, chắc chị biết.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Thế à. Em muốn cổ cao hay cổ thuyền? Lụa tơ tằm hay gấm?

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Chị có nghe rõ em vừa nói gì không đấy? Hay chị điếc thật?

50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the tailor onto the customer
35mm medium two-shot across the cutting table, locked off

steps: @Vy slides a thick red envelope across the cutting table with two fingers and is already speaking slowly and sweetly.
@Vy keeps speaking, savoring each word, red lips curling, while @Thu's pencil stops on the pad.
@Vy leans a little closer as she goes on.
@Vy lands the last words with a satisfied smile.
@Vy closes her mouth and waits for the reaction, while @Thu stays perfectly still.
@Thu lifts her eyes to @Vy and answers in a very quiet, level voice.
@Thu keeps speaking calmly and taps the pencil on the pad as if taking an ordinary order.
@Thu asks her last question without any change in her face.
@Thu closes her mouth and holds @Vy's gaze.
@Thu waits, breathing slowly, mouth closed.
@Vy blinks, her smile frozen, then snaps a quick question.
@Vy keeps talking fast, leaning in over the table.
@Vy finishes and closes her mouth, staring.
@Thu writes calmly on the order pad without looking up, mouth closed.
@Vy's fingers tighten on her handbag strap while @Thu reaches for the yellow measuring tape around her neck, both silent.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Rõ cả rồi. Giận thì tốn vải lắm em ạ. Đứng thẳng lên, chị đo cho chuẩn.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Chị bình tĩnh thế, làm em thấy sờ sợ đấy. Chị định làm gì em?

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Vai ba sáu, eo năm tám. Em gầy hơn chị nghĩ. Đứng yên nào.

clips.sfx: a stool scraping on tiles, the soft zip of a measuring tape unrolling, silk rustling, the street faint behind the glass

steps: @Thu stands, unwinds the yellow tailor's measuring tape from her neck and is already speaking slowly and evenly.
@Thu keeps speaking calmly and points toward the low fitting stand by the mirror.
@Thu goes on, unhurried, the tape hanging from her fingers.
@Thu finishes the sentence, while @Vy rises from the stool, mouth closed.
@Vy steps onto the low fitting stand, mouth closed, as the yellow tape unrolls in @Thu's hand.
@Vy blurts a quick reply with a forced laugh, swallowing hard.
@Vy keeps talking fast, eyes darting to the tape.
@Vy finishes her question and closes her mouth.
@Vy glances down at the yellow tape, mouth closed.
@Thu holds the yellow measuring tape across the back of @Vy's shoulders and starts reading the numbers aloud in a flat calm voice.
@Thu keeps talking as she slides the tape down around @Vy's waist.
@Thu adds a short last word and closes her mouth.
@Thu lets the tape fall loose and jots on the order pad, mouth closed.

scenes.title: Bữa Cơm Có Mùi Nước Hoa
scenes.location: Gian ăn cơm tầng trệt trong căn nhà ống ba tầng của gia đình Thu, trong một ngõ phố cổ Hà Nội, buổi tối cùng ngày.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đặt phía bàn thờ nhìn ra cửa: bàn ăn tròn ở giữa, gian bếp nhỏ phía sau bàn, cầu thang lát gạch dốc bên phải.
scenes.props: Mâm cơm tối với bát đũa và nồi canh nóng, bài kiểm tra điểm mười của Na (không chữ đọc được), điện thoại của Tùng (màn hình chỉ phát sáng), bình nước và cốc thuỷ tinh, cà vạt nới lỏng của Tùng.
scenes.setting: Evening inside the family's narrow three-storey tube house in an old-quarter alley: a ground-floor dining area with a round wooden table set with rice bowls and dishes, low wooden stools, a small kitchen with a gas stove behind, a steep tiled staircase, a family altar shelf with incense, warm tungsten light.

turns.speaker: @Na
turns.line: Mẹ ơi, tối nay bố có về ăn cơm không ạ? Con được điểm mười môn toán đấy!

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Thật à? Giỏi thế. Mẹ nấu toàn món bố thích, có cả canh cua, kiểu gì bố cũng về.

turns.speaker: @Na
turns.line: Thế con bày thêm bát cho bố nhé, để bố ngồi cạnh con, nghe con kể chuyện!

clips.sfx: a pot lid rattling, chopsticks clinking on china bowls, soup bubbling, a moped passing in the alley outside

steps: @Na stands by the round dining table holding up a school test paper with no readable writing and is already speaking fast, bouncing on her toes, while @Thu comes out of the small kitchen with a steaming pot of soup, mouth closed.
@Na keeps talking excitedly, waving the paper toward her mother, her pigtails bouncing.
@Na keeps speaking fast and hugs the test paper to her chest with a wide grin.
@Na keeps talking, eyes shining, as @Thu sets the pot down in the middle of the table.
@Na finishes and closes her mouth, and @Thu picks up the ladle and starts answering warmly, a touch too brightly.
@Thu keeps speaking as she ladles soup into a bowl, steam rising past her face.
@Thu keeps talking with a smile a little too wide.
@Thu keeps speaking evenly, setting the bowl at her daughter's place.
@Thu keeps talking, her eyes flicking once toward the door to the alley.
@Thu finishes, closes her mouth and rests the ladle back in the pot.
@Na picks up an extra bowl and a pair of chopsticks and chirps a quick eager reply, while @Thu listens with her mouth closed.
@Na keeps talking fast as she lays the bowl and chopsticks at the empty place beside her own stool.

@Na finishes her last words and closes her mouth, turning toward the door to the alley.

turns.speaker: @Na
turns.line: Bố ơi, xem bài con này! Cô giáo khen con trước cả lớp, các bạn còn vỗ tay nữa cơ!

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Ừ, con gái bố giỏi lắm. Bố ăn với khách rồi, hai mẹ con cứ ăn trước đi, bố lên tắm cái đã.

turns.speaker: @Na
turns.line: Nhưng bố còn chưa nhìn con lấy một cái mà...

clips.sfx: a motorbike engine cutting off in the alley, a door creaking, a phone buzzing, heavy footsteps on tiled stairs

steps: @Tung steps in from the dark alley loosening his tie, eyes on a phone with a glowing blank screen, as @Na hurries into his path holding up her test paper and is already speaking fast.
@Na keeps talking fast and beaming, the test paper with no readable writing held high in both hands, while @Tung keeps his mouth closed.
@Na bounces on her toes and keeps speaking proudly, eyes shining.
@Na keeps talking and claps the paper between her palms to show the class applauding.
@Na finishes her last words and closes her mouth, holding the paper up toward @Tung's face, while his eyes stay on the glowing phone.
@Tung answers fast without lifting his eyes from the glowing blank screen, his thumb scrolling.
@Tung keeps talking flatly, the blue-white glow on his face.
@Tung waves the phone vaguely toward the dining table and keeps speaking, still not looking down.
@Tung keeps talking as he steps around @Na toward the staircase.
@Tung keeps speaking over his shoulder, one foot on the bottom stair.
@Tung finishes, closes his mouth and starts up the steep tiled stairs, while @Na turns after him and speaks slowly in a small voice.
@Na keeps speaking softly, the test paper still lifted toward his back, her smile fading.
@Na keeps talking in a small voice, her arm sinking.
@Na finishes, closes her mouth and lowers the test paper to her side.
@Na's eyes drop to the floor, her lips pressed together, as footsteps fade up the stairs.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Chiều nay có cô khách xinh lắm đến đặt may đồ cưới. Chú rể làm giám đốc xây dựng, tên Tùng.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Thì sao? Cả Hà Nội thiếu gì người trùng tên, kể làm gì!

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Ừ, thiếu gì. Em kể cho vui thôi, em có bảo là anh đâu.

steps: @Thu, seated at the round dinner table, lifts her eyes from her rice bowl and is already speaking lightly, while @Tung, his tie hanging loose, drops onto the stool across from her and pours a glass of water.
@Thu keeps talking in an offhand voice, picking up a piece of braised fish with her chopsticks, while @Tung raises the glass to his mouth.
@Thu keeps speaking casually as @Tung gulps the water.
@Thu keeps talking evenly, her eyes resting on his face.
@Thu keeps speaking lightly, laying the piece of fish in her bowl.
@Thu says the last word gently, lays her chopsticks down and closes her mouth.
@Tung splutters into the glass, water dribbling down his chin, and answers fast between coughs.
@Tung keeps talking loudly, patting his own chest with his palm.
@Tung keeps speaking fast, his eyes darting away, then closes his mouth.
@Thu answers slowly and mildly, her eyes fixed on him, while @Tung wipes his chin with the back of his hand.
@Thu keeps speaking softly, with a faint shrug of her shoulders.
@Thu keeps talking in a mild voice, picking up her chopsticks again.
@Thu keeps speaking calmly, her eyes never leaving him.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Lạ một cái, cổ áo anh cũng thơm đúng mùi nước hoa của cô dâu ấy.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Cô đừng tưởng tượng linh tinh! Tôi tiếp khách cả ngày, ai chả xịt nước hoa! Cô theo dõi tôi à?

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Mũi em tự biết. Anh tắm đi, giặt cả áo, kẻo con ngửi thấy.

@Thu keeps speaking in a low, precise voice, her chopsticks laid neatly beside her bowl.

@Tung keeps speaking loudly, red in the face, a vein standing out at his temple.

scenes.title: Chiếc Hộp Sơn Mài Của Mẹ Chồng
scenes.time_label: Đêm, phòng bà Nhàn (02:00–03:00)
scenes.location: Phòng ngủ nhỏ của bà Nhàn trên gác căn nhà ống, đêm cùng ngày, chỉ có ánh đèn ngủ vàng.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đặt cạnh cửa sổ nhìn vào giường: bà Nhàn ngồi mép giường bên trái, Thu ngồi ghế gỗ thấp bên phải, bàn đầu giường có đèn ngủ ở giữa hai người.
scenes.props: Hộp gỗ sơn mài đỏ khảm vàng, sổ đỏ màu hồng đỏ (không chữ đọc được), tờ giấy gấp cũ ngả vàng, đèn ngủ, ghế gỗ thấp, gậy tre của bà Nhàn.
scenes.setting: Bà Nhàn's small upstairs bedroom at night: a carved wooden bed with the mosquito net looped up, an old wooden wardrobe with a mirror, a side table with a warm bedside lamp, a window onto dark tiled roofs.

turns.speaker: @Thu

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Nói sớm thì con có tin mẹ không? Hay lại nghĩ mẹ chồng đặt điều?

scenes.axis: Máy quay đặt sau gương thử đứng nhìn vào tiệm: bục thử thấp ngay trước gương, bàn cắt dài phía sau, cửa kính có chuông đồng ở xa nhất, cầu thang nhỏ trong tiệm bên trái.

@BaNhan flips the little notebook open toward @Thu, its pages showing no readable writing, and keeps speaking.
@BaNhan keeps talking, running a bony finger down the page.
@BaNhan keeps speaking with a satisfied little sniff.

@Thu keeps speaking softly, shaking her head in mock wonder.
@Thu keeps talking, setting her cloth handbag down on a stool.
@Thu keeps speaking, a soft laugh in her voice.
@Thu finishes and closes her mouth, smiling.
@BaNhan chuckles and answers with a quick reply, while @Thu's shoulders shake with a silent laugh, mouth closed.
@BaNhan keeps talking through a chuckle, tucking the notebook back into her cardigan pocket.
@BaNhan keeps speaking, wagging a finger, pleased with herself.

scenes.title: Về Quê Cô Dâu
scenes.time_label: Chiều, một làng quê Nam Định (08:00–09:00)
scenes.location: Một ngôi nhà quê vùng đồng bằng sông Hồng ở Nam Định, buổi chiều: sân gạch, hàng cau, chum nước, gian thờ treo ảnh; 09.4 là con đường gạch giữa đồng lúa lúc hoàng hôn.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đặt giữa sân gạch nhìn vào gian thờ: cổng gạch bên trái, chum nước và hàng cau bên phải, ảnh cưới lớn treo trên tường gian thờ ở giữa; 09.4 máy lùi dần trước hai người trên đường gạch, đồng lúa hai bên.
scenes.props: Giỏ quà, phiếu đặt may viết tay (không chữ đọc được), ảnh cưới lớn trong khung treo trên tường gian thờ (cô dâu tóc nâu gợn sóng kẻ mắt xếch, chú rể tóc undercut ria mép mỏng), điện thoại của Thu (màn hình trống), gậy tre của bà Nhàn.
scenes.setting: A quiet village house in the Red River Delta in the afternoon: a yellow-walled single-storey house with a tiled roof, a brick-paved front yard with areca palms and a water jar, an open front room with a wooden altar and framed photos on the wall, soft green-gold light.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Số nhà, tên xóm khớp hết với phiếu may cô ấy ghi. Đúng nhà này rồi mẹ.

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Ba tiếng ngồi xe khách, lưng mẹ gãy làm đôi rồi. Chẳng có gì thì con cõng mẹ về đấy.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Có đấy mẹ ạ. Trên tường gian thờ kia kìa.

clips.sfx: chickens clucking in a neighbour's yard, areca leaves rustling, a distant motorbike on a village road, a bamboo stick tapping on bricks

steps: @Thu steps in through the brick gate of a yellow-walled village house with a gift basket on her arm and is already speaking matter-of-factly, holding up a small handwritten slip with no readable writing beside the gatepost, while @BaNhan shuffles in behind her on her bamboo stick, mouth closed.
@Thu keeps talking, her eyes moving from the slip to the yellow wall of the house.
@Thu keeps speaking evenly, nodding once toward the open front room.
@Thu keeps talking as she folds the slip into her blouse pocket.
@Thu finishes and closes her mouth, while @BaNhan stops beside her, catching her breath.
@BaNhan presses one hand to the small of her back and starts grumbling in a dry comic voice, her wrinkled face screwed up in mock pain.
@BaNhan keeps grumbling, rubbing her lower back with her knuckles.
@BaNhan keeps talking, glaring at the yellow house.
@BaNhan keeps complaining, jabbing her bamboo stick toward the house.
@BaNhan keeps going, tapping the stick on the bricks with each word.
@BaNhan finishes with a sniff and closes her mouth.
@Thu, hiding a smile, turns toward the open front room and answers quietly, lifting her chin at the wall inside.
@Thu keeps speaking softly, her eyes on the yellow wall inside, while @BaNhan follows her gaze, mouth closed.

@BaNhan squints toward the front room and lifts a hand to shade her eyes, while @Thu waits beside her with the gift basket, both silent.

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Cô dâu trông quen quen. Phải con bé váy đỏ lau nhà cho mẹ hôm nọ không?

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Vâng, đúng nó đấy mẹ. Còn chú rể đứng bên cạnh, mẹ nhìn kỹ xem.

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Ối giời, cậu luật sư cầm cặp ngược! Hai đứa nó cưới nhau rồi à?

clips.sfx: a slow wooden clock ticking, incense crackling softly, a rooster far off, a sharp intake of breath

85mm close-up of the wife looking up at the photo, locked off

steps: @BaNhan stands beside @Thu beneath a large framed wedding photo on the yellow wall above a wooden altar, squints up at the bride and is already speaking, pointing her bamboo stick at the frame, while @Thu looks up with her mouth closed.

In the frame a bride with long wavy dark-brown hair and winged eyeliner in a white gown smiles beside a lean groom with a styled black undercut and a thin moustache, while @BaNhan keeps talking, leaning closer on her stick.
@BaNhan keeps talking, screwing up her eyes at the bride's wavy hair as incense smoke drifts across the glass.
@BaNhan keeps going, turning her head toward @Thu, eyebrows knitted.
@BaNhan finishes her question, closes her mouth and waits.

@Thu keeps speaking low and steady, lifting her chin toward the groom in the frame.
@Thu keeps talking, her gaze fixed on the thin moustache in the photo.
@Thu keeps going slowly, her face perfectly calm.
@Thu keeps speaking, finishing in the same low voice.
@Thu closes her mouth as @BaNhan peers up at the groom's thin moustache, her jaw drops, and she blurts out a fast reply.
@BaNhan keeps talking fast, jabbing her stick toward the groom, while @Thu stands beside her with her mouth closed.
@BaNhan keeps going, flapping a hand at the photo, her eyebrows flying up.
@BaNhan finishes and closes her mouth, turning to stare at @Thu.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Ba năm rồi mẹ ạ. Cỗ bày kín sân, cả xóm ai cũng biết.

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Thế thì con chụp ngay lại đi, mang về cho thằng Tùng nó sáng mắt ra.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Chưa được đâu mẹ. Bây giờ anh ấy đang mù, ảnh gì cũng bảo là ảnh ghép.

clips.sfx: a soft phone camera click, incense crackling, chickens clucking outside, wind in the areca palms

steps: @Thu, still looking up at the wedding photo, is already speaking quietly and with certainty, while @BaNhan stands beside her leaning on her bamboo stick, mouth closed.
@Thu keeps speaking calmly, her hands folded over the handle of the gift basket.
@Thu keeps talking, glancing out toward the brick yard and the neighbouring houses beyond the gate.
@Thu finishes, turning back to the photo.
@Thu closes her mouth as @BaNhan nods sharply at the photo and starts speaking briskly, flapping a hand toward @Thu's blouse pocket.

@BaNhan keeps talking, miming taking a picture with her thin old hands.

@Thu keeps talking in a low cool voice, turning the phone over in her fingers.
@Thu raises the phone toward the wedding photo on the wall as she keeps speaking.

turns.line: Hàng xóm bảo năm nào con bé cũng về khoe vớ được đại gia. Con còn đợi đến bao giờ?

turns.line: Đến đúng hôm anh ấy tự tay trao sính lễ cho vợ người ta, mẹ ạ.

turns.speaker: @BaNhan

steps: @BaNhan and @Thu walk slowly up a narrow brick lane between bamboo hedges toward the camera at sunset; @BaNhan is already speaking with a gossipy tilt of her head, while @Thu carries the empty gift basket with her mouth closed.
@BaNhan keeps talking, her bamboo stick tapping the bricks, nodding back toward the village.

scenes.title: Bé Na Theo Bố
scenes.time_label: Cuối tuần, trước tiệm may rồi đêm trong tiệm (09:00–10:00)
scenes.location: Vỉa hè trước tiệm may áo dài phố Hàng Gai (10.1), trong tiệm ban ngày (10.2) và trong tiệm ban đêm (10.3–10.4).
scenes.axis: 10.1 máy đặt trên vỉa hè ngang tầm trẻ con, cửa kính tiệm bên trái, xe sang đen bên phải. Trong tiệm: máy đặt sau bàn cắt nhìn ra cửa kính, máy may bên trái, cầu thang trong tiệm phía sau; ban đêm cửa cuốn kéo nửa chừng, ma-nơ-canh mặc áo cưới đang may cạnh máy may.
scenes.props: Máy tính bảng màu hồng (màn hình trống), ba lô nhỏ và áo khoác của Na, áo dài cưới đỏ thêu phượng vàng đang may trên ma-nơ-canh, đèn bàn, thước dây vàng, ghế đẩu.
scenes.setting: Thu's narrow áo dài tailor shop on an old-quarter silk street by day: bolts of jewel-toned silk stacked on wooden shelves to the ceiling, two headless dress forms in half-finished áo dài, an old black sewing machine on a worn wooden table, a tall standing fitting mirror, a long cutting table with tailor's chalk and paper patterns, a small brass bell above the glass door, soft daylight from the street.

turns.speaker: @Vy

turns.speaker: @Na
turns.line: Mẹ không giận ạ? Con cứ tưởng mẹ không cho, con còn định khóc cơ.

scenes.title: Bể Bơi Trên Tầng Thượng
scenes.time_label: Thứ bảy, căn hộ của Vy (10:00–11:00)
scenes.location: Căn hộ cao cấp của Vy trên cao nhìn xuống Hà Nội ban ngày (11.1–11.3); tiệm may của Thu ban đêm (11.4).
scenes.axis: Máy đặt cạnh cửa kính nhìn vào phòng khách: sofa da trắng ở giữa, đảo bếp đá bên trái, cửa ra vào bên phải; 11.4 trong tiệm may đêm, máy ngang tầm trẻ con cạnh máy may nhìn ra cửa cuốn.

turns.line: Thôi em cúp đây, lão ấy sắp về rồi. Tối mình nói tiếp.

clips.sfx: a phone buzzing, the hum of air conditioning, long fingernails tapping on glass, paper crinkling

85mm close-up of the girl on the white sofa, slow push-in
50mm medium shot of the young woman at the floor-to-ceiling window, the city bright behind her, locked off

steps: A phone with a glowing blank screen at her ear, @Vy straightens up from the sofa and is already speaking fast and low into it with an irritated roll of her eyes, while @Na kneels by the sofa with her drawing, mouth closed.
@Vy keeps talking, turning her back on the sofa, her lips pressed thin.
@Vy keeps going, flicking a glance back over her shoulder toward @Na.
@Vy keeps speaking low and fast, rolling her eyes, as she walks toward the floor-to-ceiling window.
@Vy keeps talking, her free hand on her hip, her voice flat and cold.
@Vy finishes and closes her mouth, listening to the phone, her back to the room.
On the white sofa @Na, who has heard every word, begins to whisper slowly to herself, her eyes lowered.
@Na keeps whispering, holding her crayon drawing close.
@Na keeps whispering, her eyes on the drawing.
@Na whispers the last words and closes her mouth, looking quietly toward the door.
@Vy at the window glances toward the front door and speaks quickly into the phone again, suddenly brisk.
@Vy keeps talking fast, tapping her long red nails on the window glass.
@Vy keeps going, a sly smile at the city below.
@Vy finishes and closes her mouth, lowering the phone.
@Vy slips the phone into her small white handbag and smooths her hair, never turning round, mouth closed.

turns.speaker: @Na
turns.line: Bố ơi, đưa con về đi. Lúc nãy cô ấy gọi điện, con nghe thấy hết rồi.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Con nghe nhầm rồi. Cô thương con lắm, còn mua cả máy tính bảng cho con đấy thôi.

turns.speaker: @Na
turns.line: Bố cũng chẳng chịu nghe con nói. Bố chỉ cắm mặt vào máy thôi.

clips.sfx: the apartment door clicking shut, a tie sliding loose, the hum of air conditioning, a small sniffle

shots.camera: 50mm medium two-shot at the apartment door, low angle, locked off
85mm close-up of the crouching father, locked off
40mm medium two-shot by the door, the standing father and the girl looking up at him, slow drift

steps: The apartment front door swings open and @Tung walks in loosening his tie, as @Na scrambles up from beside her small school backpack and is already speaking in a small pleading voice.
@Na keeps talking, stepping toward him with the backpack in both arms, while @Tung crouches down to her eye level with his mouth closed.
@Na keeps going, her chin quivering, glancing back toward the window.
@Na keeps speaking, hugging the backpack tight.
@Na finishes and closes her mouth, looking up at him with wet eyes.
@Tung sighs and answers in a tired, even voice, glancing at a phone with a glowing blank screen in his hand.
@Tung keeps talking, forcing a weary smile.
@Tung keeps speaking, his thumb already scrolling on the phone.
@Tung keeps going, nodding absently at the screen.
@Tung finishes, closes his mouth and stands up, thumbing the phone.
@Na looks up at him and says a quiet flat line, her eyes wet.
@Na keeps speaking flatly, while @Tung reads his phone with his mouth closed.
@Na keeps going, staring at the glowing phone in his hand.
@Na finishes and closes her mouth, holding her backpack.
@Na stays still by the door, eyes wet, while @Tung walks past her toward the window, his eyes on the phone, both silent.

turns.speaker: @Na
turns.line: Mẹ ơi, nhà bố có bể bơi nhưng không có mẹ. Quà của cô ấy con để lại tất cả.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Ừ. Con gái mẹ lớn thật rồi, biết tự tìm đường về. Lại đây với mẹ nào.

turns.speaker: @Na
turns.line: Lần sau con không sang bên ấy nữa đâu, mẹ nhé.

clips.setting: Night in Thu's narrow áo dài tailor shop: the steel shutter half down, a single warm desk lamp over the old black sewing machine, bolts of silk fading into shadow on the shelves, two headless dress forms, a long cutting table with paper patterns.
clips.sfx: the shutter rattling, small hurried footsteps, a muffled sob, the desk lamp humming

steps: Night in the tailor shop: @Na ducks in under the half-open steel shutter with her backpack, tears on her cheeks, and is already speaking fast between small sobs.
@Na keeps talking in a rush of words, wiping her eyes with the back of her hand.
@Na keeps going, her voice catching, the backpack slipping off one shoulder.
@Na keeps speaking, sniffing hard, her small hands clenched on the straps.
@Na finishes, shaking her head hard, pigtails swinging.
@Na closes her mouth as @Thu kneels down before her in the warm lamplight and begins to answer softly.
@Thu keeps speaking softly with a trembling smile, her eyes shining.
@Thu keeps talking, her voice catching as she nods at her daughter.
@Thu keeps going, the red wedding áo dài glowing on its dress form in the shadows behind her.
@Thu keeps speaking and finishes, slowly opening her arms.
@Thu closes her mouth, arms open; @Na steps into her mother's arms and says a small muffled reply, her face turned toward the camera.
@Na keeps speaking in a small voice, her cheek against @Thu's shoulder.
@Na keeps going, her eyes squeezed shut.
@Na finishes and closes her mouth.
@Thu rests her chin on @Na's head and the two hold each other close in the lamplight, both silent.

scenes.title: Năm Tỷ Sính Lễ
scenes.time_label: Thứ hai, văn phòng giám đốc (11:00–12:00)
scenes.location: Văn phòng giám đốc vách kính trên cao ốc Hà Nội (12.1–12.3); thang máy kính ốp gương trong toà nhà (12.4).
scenes.axis: Máy đặt cạnh các mô hình toà nhà nhìn về bàn gỗ lớn trước vách kính: ghế da của Tùng sau bàn, khách đứng hoặc ngồi phía trước bàn; 12.4 trong thang máy, hai người đứng cạnh nhau quay mặt vào vách gương.
scenes.props: Cặp tài liệu da đen (Khải cầm đúng chiều), máy tính bảng đen màn hình trống, điện thoại của Tùng, thỏi son đỏ của Vy, mô hình toà nhà trắng.
scenes.setting: Tùng's glass-walled director's office high in a Hà Nội tower by day: a big dark wood desk, white architectural models of towers under glass, a black leather chair, crisp cold daylight over the city.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Anh ơi, bố mẹ em ở quê khó tính lắm. Ngoài căn nhà, phải thêm năm tỷ sính lễ thì mới gả.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Năm tỷ thì anh xoay được. Còn căn nhà phải đợi bà ấy ký đã, em cứ từ từ.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Từ từ đến bao giờ? Thế anh giục nhanh lên.

clips.sfx: the hush of air conditioning, a leather chair creaking, distant city traffic far below, a pen clicking

shots.camera: 50mm medium shot of the young woman standing beside the dark wood desk, slow push-in
85mm close-up of the man in the black leather chair, locked off

steps: In the glass-walled director's office, @Vy stands beside the dark wood desk, one hand resting on the wood, tilts her head with a little pout and is already speaking sweetly, while @Tung leans back in the black leather chair with his mouth closed.
@Vy keeps talking in a wheedling voice, twirling a strand of wavy hair.
@Vy keeps going, glancing at the white tower models under glass.
@Vy keeps speaking, holding up one hand with all her fingers spread.
@Vy keeps talking, smiling sweetly at him across the desk.
@Vy finishes and closes her mouth, folding her hands.
@Tung rubs his jaw and answers hesitantly, his eyes sliding toward the window.
@Tung keeps talking, tapping his gold wristwatch with one finger.
@Tung keeps speaking, shifting in the leather chair.
@Tung keeps going, waving one hand in a calming gesture.
@Tung keeps talking, avoiding her eyes.

@Vy keeps talking fast, pouting, her fingernail still tapping the wood.

@Vy steps back from the desk with a small smug smile, while @Tung reaches for his phone on the desk, both silent.

turns.line: Được. Cậu là anh họ của Vy thì tôi tin. Chiều nay tôi bảo kế toán lo.

turns.speaker: @Khai
turns.line: Người nhà cả mà anh. Phí luật sư em miễn hết, coi như quà cưới.

clips.sfx: a leather folder sliding on wood, the hush of air conditioning, a chair creaking, a fingertip tapping leather

steps: In the glass-walled office, @Khai stands across the dark wood desk, turns a black leather document folder the right way up with a showy flourish and is already speaking fast and smoothly.
@Khai keeps talking, opening the folder and fanning a few papers with no readable writing.
@Khai keeps going, smoothing his thin moustache with one finger, his sly half-smile fixed.
@Khai keeps speaking smoothly, tapping the papers twice.
@Khai finishes and closes his mouth, sliding the folder across the desk.
@Tung nods slowly and answers in an even voice, tapping the folder, while @Khai in the foreground keeps his mouth closed.
@Tung keeps talking, nodding along, a confident smile spreading.
@Tung keeps speaking, picking up a pen.
@Tung keeps going, pointing the pen toward the phone on the desk.
@Tung finishes and closes his mouth, settling back in the black leather chair.
@Khai spreads his palms and replies quickly with a generous grin.
@Khai keeps talking, his voice silky, one eyebrow lifting.
@Khai keeps going, the half-smile turning faintly mocking.
@Khai finishes and closes his mouth, sliding the folder a little closer to @Tung.
@Tung leans back with his mouth closed, nodding, while @Khai smooths his moustache and smiles, both silent.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Xong chưa anh? Bố mẹ ở quê gọi em suốt từ sáng đến giờ.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Xong hết rồi, không thiếu thứ gì. Từ giờ em là bà giám đốc, thích gì cứ bảo anh.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Cảm ơn ông xã. Anh yên tâm, em làm vợ anh, đúng một ngày thôi.

clips.sfx: a soft tablet chime, a phone buzzing, the hush of air conditioning, heels shifting on a polished floor

steps: In the glass-walled office, @Vy stands at the desk beside @Tung, clasps her hands and is already speaking in an eager, sugary voice, while @Tung smiles with his mouth closed.
@Vy keeps talking, tilting her head toward a slim black tablet with a glowing blank screen on the desk.
@Vy keeps going, rolling her eyes playfully.
@Vy finishes and closes her mouth, her eyes bright and eager.
@Tung taps the slim black tablet with a flourish and starts answering proudly.
@Tung keeps talking, spreading his arms wide, chin raised.
@Tung keeps going expansively, a broad grin on his face.
@Tung keeps speaking proudly, laying a palm on his chest.
@Tung keeps talking as his phone buzzes on the desk beside him.
@Tung closes his mouth and turns toward the window, lifting the phone to his ear with his back to her; @Vy begins to speak in a purring voice.
@Vy keeps speaking sweetly to his back, her smile beginning to fade.
@Vy keeps talking, her voice dropping, the sweetness draining from her face.
@Vy keeps going, watching his back with flat eyes.
@Vy says the last words with an ice-cold smile and closes her mouth.
@Vy watches his back with flat, cold eyes, mouth closed, while @Tung's blurred figure at the window keeps listening to the phone.

turns.speaker: @Khai
turns.line: Năm tỷ nằm gọn trong tài khoản rồi em. Tiệc xong là mình bay chuyến sớm nhất.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Đặt hạng thương gia nhé. Diễn vợ hiền ba lần rồi, lần này em phải được ngồi ghế tử tế.

turns.speaker: @Khai
turns.line: Hạng nhất luôn. Lão ấy trả tiền vé cho mình mà, khách sáo gì.

clips.setting: Inside a mirrored glass elevator in a Hà Nội office tower by day: brushed steel walls, soft white light, the city skyline sliding past behind the glass.
clips.sfx: the soft hum of the elevator, a lipstick cap clicking shut, a gentle chime as floors pass, wind murmuring against the glass

steps: Inside a mirrored glass elevator, the steel doors sliding shut, @Khai leans toward @Vy and is already speaking fast and low, while @Vy touches up her red lipstick in the mirror with her mouth closed.
@Khai keeps talking urgently, glancing at the closed doors.
@Khai keeps going, patting the pocket of his beige chinos with a sly grin.
@Khai finishes, raising his eyebrows at her reflection.
@Khai closes his mouth; @Vy caps the lipstick with a click and answers with a cocky smile, watching his reflection.
@Vy keeps talking, amused, smoothing one eyebrow with a fingertip.
@Vy keeps going, rolling her eyes in mock weariness.
@Vy keeps speaking, holding up three fingers with a smirk.
@Vy keeps talking, her red lips curling.
@Vy finishes with a little laugh and closes her mouth.
@Khai leans back against the brushed steel wall and replies quickly with a smug grin.
@Khai keeps talking, straightening his silver chain bracelet.
@Khai finishes with a wink at her reflection.
@Khai closes his mouth, while @Vy drops the lipstick into her small white handbag.
The two stand side by side in silence, sharing a slow sly smile in the mirror as the skyline keeps sliding past the glass.

scenes.title: Chính Thất Đồng Ý Ly Hôn
scenes.time_label: Chiều, quán cà phê nhìn ra hồ Gươm (12:00–13:00)
scenes.location: Quán cà phê sân thượng nhìn xuống hồ Hoàn Kiếm, chiều muộn.
scenes.axis: Máy đặt trong quán, chếch về phía lan can, nhìn vào bàn: Thu ngồi bên trái, Tùng bên phải, lan can và mặt hồ Gươm phía sau lưng hai người.
scenes.props: Hai tách trà, xấp đơn ly hôn (không chữ đọc được), ghế mây, chậu hoa giấy.
scenes.setting: A quiet rooftop café overlooking Hoàn Kiếm Lake in late afternoon: small wooden tables, rattan chairs, potted bougainvillea, the lake and its old trees glowing in golden light below.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Em đồng ý ly hôn. Giấy tờ anh đưa, em ký hết, không tranh gì cả.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Thật à? Cô biết điều từ bao giờ thế? Tôi cứ tưởng phải lôi nhau ra toà.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Ra toà thì ít người xem quá. Chuyện vui thế này phải đông mới hay.

clips.sfx: teaspoons clinking on china, a breeze in the bougainvillea, birds calling over the lake, distant traffic around the lake

85mm close-up of the husband in the rattan chair, locked off

steps: On a rooftop café in golden late-afternoon light, @Thu sits on the left of a small wooden table, hands folded beside her tea and a thin stack of papers with no readable writing, and is already speaking slowly and evenly.
@Thu keeps talking calmly, her eyes steady across the table.
@Thu keeps speaking, laying two fingers on the stack of papers.
@Thu keeps going, sliding the papers a little toward the other side of the table.
@Thu finishes and closes her mouth, folding her hands again.
@Tung stops stirring his tea, leans back with a smug grin and answers fast.
@Tung keeps talking with a surprised laugh, eyebrows high.
@Tung keeps going, wagging his teaspoon in the air.
@Tung keeps speaking, shaking his head in amusement.
@Tung closes his mouth and spreads his arms along the rattan chair; @Thu calmly lifts her teacup and answers in a dry, light voice.
@Thu keeps speaking lightly, the cup near her lips.
@Thu keeps talking, glancing at the other tables with a faint smile.
@Thu keeps going, her voice almost playful.
@Thu keeps speaking and finishes, blowing gently on the tea.
@Thu closes her mouth and sips her tea, watching him over the rim, while @Tung sits stiffly in the foreground, both silent.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Có một điều kiện. Em sẽ ký ở đám hỏi của anh, trước mặt hai họ.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Trước mặt bao nhiêu người? Cô định tự bôi tro trát trấu vào mặt mình à?

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Còn áo cưới, em tự mang đến tận tay cô dâu. Hàng của em, em giao.

clips.sfx: china cups clinking, leaves rustling in the breeze, birds calling over the lake, a teacup set down on wood

85mm close-up of the husband, the lake soft behind him, locked off

steps: @Thu raises one finger and is already speaking slowly, her eyes steady on @Tung, while @Tung holds his teacup halfway to his lips with his mouth closed.
@Thu keeps speaking, every word placed, her finger still raised.
@Thu keeps talking quietly, lowering her hand to the table.
@Thu keeps speaking, her gaze unwavering, her face calm.
@Thu finishes and closes her mouth, her eyes still on him.
@Tung sets his cup down, tips his head back with a laugh and answers scornfully.
@Tung keeps talking, laughing, sweeping a hand toward the other tables.
@Tung keeps going, pointing at his own cheek with a mocking grimace.
@Tung keeps speaking scornfully, shaking his head.
@Tung closes his mouth, still smirking; @Thu answers slowly and evenly, resting her fingertips on the stack of papers.
@Thu keeps speaking, unruffled, sliding the papers to the middle of the table.
@Thu keeps talking calmly as @Tung's eyebrows climb, his mouth closed.
@Thu keeps going, tapping the table once with a fingertip.
@Thu keeps speaking, then finishes, watching him calmly over the rim of her teacup.
@Thu closes her mouth, while @Tung leans forward over the table, his jaw jutting, both silent.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Tuỳ cô. Nhưng nhớ đấy, nhà phải về tay tôi. Tôi hứa với nhà gái rồi, cô đừng có lật lọng.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Anh yên tâm. Căn nhà ấy sẽ về đúng tay người chủ thật của nó.
turns.tone: a faint smile in the voice

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Được. Thế mới phải chứ. Ký xong thì đường ai nấy đi, khỏi dây dưa.

clips.sfx: a finger tapping on paper, a teacup set down on wood, the breeze in the bougainvillea, a bicycle bell far below

steps: @Tung leans forward over the table and is already speaking fast, tapping a finger on the stack of papers, while @Thu sits upright with her hands around her teacup, mouth closed.
@Tung keeps talking, jabbing his finger at the papers.
@Tung keeps going, his voice clipped and demanding.
@Tung keeps speaking, narrowing his heavy-lidded eyes.
@Tung finishes and closes his mouth, his jaw jutting.

@Thu keeps speaking softly, her eyes drifting to the lake beyond the railing.

@Thu keeps going slowly, turning back to look at him.

@Tung keeps talking, leaning back in the rattan chair, pleased with himself.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Lấy nhau ngần ấy năm, giờ cô mới làm được một việc tôi hài lòng.

turns.speaker: @Thu

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Đo với chả đếm. Thôi tôi về đây, tiền nước thì cô trả nhé.

clips.sfx: a rattan chair creaking, footsteps fading across the wooden deck, a teacup touching its saucer, birds over the lake

steps: @Tung rises from the rattan chair, buttoning his suit jacket, and is already speaking in an arrogant, unhurried voice, looking down across the table at @Thu.
@Tung keeps talking, a superior smile tugging at his mouth.

@Tung keeps speaking, tilting his chin up.

scenes.title: Buổi Thử Áo Cuối Cùng
scenes.time_label: Ba ngày trước đám hỏi, tiệm may (13:00–14:00)
scenes.location: Tiệm may áo dài của Thu trên phố Hàng Gai, ban ngày, ba ngày trước đám hỏi.
scenes.axis: Máy đặt cạnh kệ lụa nhìn về gương thử đứng: bục thử trước gương ở giữa, bàn cắt bên trái, cửa kính có chuông đồng ở xa nhất.
scenes.props: Áo dài cưới đỏ thêu phượng vàng hoàn chỉnh (Vy đang thử, chưa có khăn vấn), khăn vấn đỏ, hộp đựng áo dài màu đỏ thắt nơ vàng (khăn vấn giao cùng áo hôm ăn hỏi), gối cắm kim, thước dây vàng.
scenes.setting: Thu's narrow áo dài tailor shop on an old-quarter silk street by day: bolts of jewel-toned silk stacked on wooden shelves to the ceiling, two headless dress forms in half-finished áo dài, an old black sewing machine on a worn wooden table, a tall standing fitting mirror, a long cutting table with tailor's chalk and paper patterns, a small brass bell above the glass door, soft daylight from the street.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Đẹp thật đấy. Chị may cho người cướp chồng mình mà khéo thế à? Em cứ tưởng chị cắt hỏng cho bõ tức.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Làm nghề thì phải tử tế. Áo đẹp hay không còn tuỳ người mặc.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Ý chị là em không xứng chứ gì? Chị nói thẳng ra xem nào.

wardrobe.@Vy: a red silk wedding áo dài embroidered with a gold phoenix, a thin gold necklace, beige high heels

clips.sfx: silk rustling, a pin dropping into a tin, a wall clock ticking, street traffic muffled behind the glass

85mm close-up of the tailor rising from the hem, locked off
40mm medium two-shot beside the fitting mirror, slow drift

steps: In the tailor shop by day, @Vy, in a red silk wedding áo dài embroidered with a gold phoenix, turns slowly on the low fitting stand before the tall mirror and is already speaking as she admires herself, while @Thu kneels at the hem with a pincushion, mouth closed.
@Vy keeps talking, smoothing the gold phoenix over her waist, a mocking smile on her red lips.
@Vy keeps going, lifting the hem a little to admire the stitching.
@Vy keeps speaking, glancing down at @Thu with a smirk.
@Vy keeps talking, tilting her chin at her own reflection.
@Vy keeps speaking, turning her shoulders left and right before the mirror.
@Vy finishes and closes her mouth; @Thu rises from the hem, steps back to look at it and answers slowly and dryly.
@Thu keeps speaking calmly, her eyes running along the seam.
@Thu keeps talking, sliding a pin into the pincushion on her wrist.
@Thu keeps going, her face composed, one corner of her mouth lifting.
@Thu finishes and closes her mouth, meeting @Vy's eyes in the mirror.
@Vy's smile tightens and she answers with a quick needling question, her eyes narrowed at @Thu's reflection.
@Vy keeps talking sharply, turning half round toward @Thu.
@Vy keeps going, lifting her chin higher.
@Vy closes her mouth and waits, while @Thu calmly steps up behind her at the shoulder seam, her face clear in the mirror, both silent.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Quê em ở Nam Định nhỉ? Chị vừa về dưới ấy. Làng em đẹp, nhà nào cũng treo ảnh cưới thật to.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Chị về quê em làm gì? Chị điều tra em à? Ai cho chị cái quyền ấy?

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Chị đi giao áo cho mấy khách quen mà. Tiện thì ghé.

wardrobe.@Vy: a red silk wedding áo dài embroidered with a gold phoenix, a thin gold necklace, beige high heels

clips.sfx: pins clicking into a tin, silk rustling, a wall clock ticking, a sharp swish of silk

shots.camera: 40mm medium two-shot beside the fitting mirror, holding the previous framing
85mm close-up of the bride spinning round from the mirror, locked off
50mm medium two-shot from the side of the fitting stand, locked off

steps: @Thu stands behind @Vy at the tall mirror, slipping pins out of the shoulder seam of the red áo dài one by one, and is already speaking casually without looking up, while @Vy admires her reflection, mouth closed.
@Thu keeps chatting lightly, dropping each pin into the pincushion.
@Thu keeps talking with a small easy smile, her fingers working along the seam.
@Thu keeps going, glancing up at the bride's reflection for a moment.
@Thu keeps speaking pleasantly, while @Vy's smile in the mirror freezes.
@Thu keeps talking a moment longer, then closes her mouth and returns her eyes to the seam.
@Vy spins round away from the mirror to face @Thu and speaks fast and sharp, her eyes narrowed.
@Vy keeps talking, her red nails curling at her sides.
@Vy keeps going, her voice rising.
@Vy finishes and closes her mouth, breathing hard through her nose.
@Thu calmly slides another pin into the pincushion and answers lightly and innocently.
@Thu keeps speaking, her face unreadable, while @Vy stares at her with her mouth closed.
@Thu keeps talking, kneeling down to the hem.
@Thu finishes and closes her mouth, her eyes on the hem.
@Vy turns back toward the mirror, jaw tight, glaring at @Thu's reflection, both silent.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Chị đừng có giở trò với em. Ngày vui của em mà có chuyện gì, em cho chị trắng tay ra đường, đến cái tiệm may cỏn con này cũng không còn!

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Trắng tay thì chị quen rồi em ạ, ngày xưa chị cũng thế. Chị chỉ lo cho người chưa quen thôi.

wardrobe.@Vy: a red silk wedding áo dài embroidered with a gold phoenix, a thin gold necklace, beige high heels

clips.sfx: a fingernail tapping on glass, pins clicking into a tin, silk rustling, the street muffled behind the glass door

shots.camera: 50mm medium two-shot from the side of the fitting stand, holding the previous framing
85mm close-up of the bride glaring into the mirror, locked off
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the bride down onto the kneeling tailor
40mm medium two-shot in the fitting corner, slow pull-back

steps: @Vy leans in, points a red-nailed finger at @Thu's reflection in the tall mirror and is already speaking fast and low through her teeth, while @Thu kneels at the hem with a pincushion, mouth closed.
@Vy keeps talking fast, her fingernail tapping the mirror glass, never touching @Thu.
@Vy keeps going, her nostrils flared.
@Vy keeps speaking spitefully, her winged eyes narrowed at the mirror.
@Vy keeps talking, her voice rising, her chin jutting.
@Vy keeps going, sweeping one hand at the silk shelves around the shop.
@Vy keeps speaking through her teeth to the last word, glaring.
@Vy closes her mouth; @Thu, still unpinning the hem with steady hands, begins to answer slowly and softly.
@Thu keeps speaking softly, dropping a pin into the pincushion.
@Thu keeps talking, lifting her eyes to the bride.
@Thu keeps going, drops the last pin into the pincushion and slowly rises to her feet.
@Thu keeps speaking, now standing an arm's length from @Vy, never touching her.
@Thu keeps talking, folding her hands on her apron.
@Thu finishes and closes her mouth, holding @Vy's gaze.
@Vy's pointing hand slowly lowers, her jaw tight, while @Thu turns calmly toward the cutting table beside the mirror, where a long flat red garment box waits, both silent.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Chị nói thế là ý gì? Sao lại nhìn em như thế? Em có nợ ai đâu.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Khăn vấn chị để riêng trong hộp này. Hôm ấy chị mang đến tận nơi, kèm một món quà nhỏ.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Đến sớm vào, đừng để em phải đợi. Em ghét nhất là chờ.

wardrobe.@Vy: a red silk wedding áo dài embroidered with a gold phoenix, a thin gold necklace, beige high heels

clips.sfx: a box lid closing softly, satin ribbon sliding, a wall clock ticking, a held breath

85mm close-up of the tailor at the cutting table, the red box before her, slow push-in
50mm over-the-shoulder shot from behind the tailor onto the bride on the fitting stand

steps: @Vy turns her head from the mirror toward @Thu and is already speaking fast and sharp, her eyes darting, covering it with a brittle laugh, while @Thu stands at the cutting table, mouth closed.
@Vy keeps talking fast, smoothing the red silk at her waist.
@Vy keeps going, shaking her head too quickly.
@Vy keeps speaking, swallowing.
@Vy closes her mouth; @Thu lays a red khăn vấn headband into a long flat red garment box on the cutting table and begins to answer slowly and evenly.
@Thu keeps speaking politely, smoothing the red headband flat inside the box.
@Thu keeps talking, closing the lid of the red box.
@Thu keeps going, knotting a gold ribbon around the red box.
@Thu keeps speaking, smoothing the gold bow with her fingertips.
@Thu keeps talking, lifting her eyes to the bride's reflection in the mirror, and finishes.
@Thu closes her mouth, her hands resting on the box; @Vy calls out a bossy order a little too loudly from the fitting stand.
@Vy keeps talking loudly, pointing at the red box.
@Vy keeps going, her chin high.
@Vy finishes and closes her mouth, standing stiff before the mirror in the red áo dài, her jaw tight.
@Thu rests her palm on the red box and inclines her head politely, while @Vy stays rigid on the fitting stand, both silent.

scenes.title: Đêm Trước Đám Hỏi
scenes.time_label: Đêm trước đám hỏi (14:00–15:00)
scenes.location: Tiệm may ban đêm (15.1–15.2), căn hộ của Vy ban đêm (15.3), nhà ống của gia đình Tùng buổi tối (15.4).
scenes.axis: 15.1–15.2 trong tiệm đêm: máy may và đèn bàn bên trái, ma-nơ-canh mặc áo cưới đỏ ở giữa, cầu thang trong tiệm bên phải; 15.3 căn hộ: đảo bếp đá ở giữa, cửa kính đầy đèn phía sau; 15.4 nhà ống: máy đặt cạnh bàn thờ, bà Nhàn ngồi tiền cảnh quay lưng vào phòng, Tùng ở cửa phía sau.
scenes.props: Điện thoại của Thu (màn hình trống), áo cưới đỏ hoàn chỉnh trên ma-nơ-canh, đôi giày vải trắng của Na, túi xách trắng của Vy, hai thẻ lên máy bay không chữ, sâm panh, bàn thờ và nén nhang.
scenes.setting: Night in Thu's narrow áo dài tailor shop: the steel shutter half down, a single warm desk lamp over the old black sewing machine, bolts of silk fading into shadow on the shelves, two headless dress forms, a long cutting table with paper patterns.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Vâng, ảnh cưới với địa chỉ quê họ em gửi anh rồi. Đây là lần thứ ba họ làm thế, lần nào cũng một bài. Tối mai, ở sảnh tiệc khách sạn. Vâng, em sẽ giữ họ ở lại đến khi các anh tới. Anh cứ yên tâm.
turns.tone: steady and low, on the phone

clips.sfx: the desk lamp humming, a soft click as the call ends, the steel shutter creaking in the night breeze, a motorbike passing far off

shots.camera: 50mm medium shot of the wife at the sewing machine in the lamplight, locked off
85mm close-up of the wife on the phone, lamplight on one side of her face, slow push-in
50mm medium profile shot past the red áo dài on its dress form toward the wife, slow rack focus
85mm close-up of the wife at the sewing table in the lamplight, locked off

steps: Night in the tailor shop under a single warm desk lamp: @Thu sits at the old black sewing machine with a phone with a glowing blank screen at her ear and is already speaking in a low, steady voice.
@Thu keeps talking evenly, glancing at the half-lowered steel shutter.
@Thu keeps speaking, her free hand running along the yellow measuring tape around her neck.
@Thu keeps talking quietly, her eyes on the finished red silk wedding áo dài embroidered with a gold phoenix on a dress form across the room.
@Thu keeps going, nodding slowly as she listens and answers.
@Thu keeps speaking low, her expression calm, the lamplight on her cheek.
@Thu keeps talking, her eyes thoughtful.
@Thu keeps speaking steadily, tapping two fingers on the sewing table.
@Thu keeps talking, turning on the stool toward the dress form.
@Thu keeps speaking, her eyes on the gold phoenix, the phone pressed to her ear.
@Thu keeps going with a calm, decisive nod.
@Thu keeps talking quietly into the phone, a small steady smile, her face clearly in view.
@Thu adds her last calm words, then closes her mouth and lowers the phone.
@Thu sets the phone down, its glow fading on her cheek, mouth closed.
@Thu lifts her eyes toward the red wedding áo dài just beyond the frame, a steady gaze, silent.

turns.speaker: @Na
turns.line: Mẹ ơi, mai mẹ đi đám hỏi của bố thật à? Mẹ có buồn không? Con thấy mẹ ngồi khâu mãi.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Mẹ không đi ăn hỏi. Mẹ đi giao áo, giao xong là về với con ngay.

turns.speaker: @Na
turns.line: Thế con thức đợi mẹ về nhé. Con không ngủ đâu.

clips.sfx: small feet on wooden stairs, the desk lamp humming, a cricket chirping outside, the night street quiet beyond the shutter

shots.camera: 50mm medium shot of the girl on the narrow staircase, locked off
85mm close-up of the mother crouching at the foot of the stairs, locked off
40mm medium two-shot at the foot of the staircase, slow push-in

steps: At the back of the lamplit tailor shop at night, @Na comes down the narrow inner staircase in her school uniform, rubbing her eyes, and is already speaking in a small sleepy voice.
@Na keeps talking, holding the banister, her pigtails loose.
@Na keeps asking, sitting down on the bottom step beside a small pair of white canvas shoes.
@Na keeps speaking, hugging her knees, looking toward the lamp over the sewing machine.
@Na keeps talking, pointing sleepily at the red áo dài glowing on its dress form.
@Na finishes and closes her mouth, her chin on her knees.
@Thu, crouching in front of the bottom step, answers warmly.
@Thu keeps speaking gently, with a soft reassuring smile.
@Thu keeps talking, tilting her head to meet @Na's eyes.
@Thu keeps going and tucks a loose strand of hair behind @Na's ear.
@Thu finishes and closes her mouth.
@Na gives a small sleepy smile and says a drowsy reply.
@Na keeps speaking drowsily, her eyelids drooping, while @Thu listens with her mouth closed.
@Na finishes and closes her mouth, leaning her head against the banister.
@Thu strokes @Na's hair once and watches her doze, both silent.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Sao trong túi em lại có hai vé bay sáng ngày kia? Xong tiệc là đi luôn à?

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Vé đi trăng mật của mình chứ còn gì! Em định để dành làm quà bất ngờ. Anh lại đa nghi rồi, em giận đấy.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Thôi, anh xin lỗi. Dạo này anh mệt quá.

clips.setting: A glossy luxury apartment high above Hà Nội at night: floor-to-ceiling windows full of city lights, a white leather sofa, a marble kitchen island with a bottle of champagne and two glasses, cold blue-white light.
clips.sfx: champagne glasses clinking, a handbag clasp clicking shut, the hum of the city far below, paper rustling

85mm close-up of the young woman, city lights behind her, locked off

steps: In the glossy apartment at night, @Tung stands at the marble kitchen island beside a small white handbag lying open, holds up two boarding passes with no readable writing and is already speaking with a puzzled frown.
@Tung keeps talking, turning the passes over in his fingers.
@Tung keeps going, one eyebrow raised, glancing toward the window.
@Tung keeps speaking, holding the passes out at arm's length.
@Tung finishes and closes his mouth, waiting, as @Vy walks in from the window.
@Vy laughs brightly and answers fast and sweetly, plucking the boarding passes from his fingers.
@Vy keeps talking too quickly, fluttering the passes in front of her smile.
@Vy keeps going, pressing the passes to her heart with a dreamy look.
@Vy keeps speaking, pouting playfully, her voice sugary.
@Vy keeps talking, wagging one finger at him in mock offence.
@Vy finishes and closes her mouth with a little pout.
@Tung rubs the back of his neck and says a short sheepish line.
@Tung keeps speaking sheepishly, while @Vy tucks the boarding passes deep into her handbag, mouth closed.
@Tung finishes and closes his mouth.
@Vy clicks the handbag shut and pours two glasses of champagne with a bright smile, while @Tung looks down, both silent.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Mai mẹ có đến không? Hay mẹ lại ngồi nhà bênh cái Thu như mọi khi? Mẹ nói một câu đi.

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Mẹ sẽ đến. Mẹ đến để xem con trai mẹ tự tay đào hố chôn mình.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Mẹ nói gở vừa thôi! Mai là ngày vui của con đấy.

clips.setting: Evening inside the family's narrow three-storey tube house in an old-quarter alley: a ground-floor dining area with a round wooden table set with rice bowls and dishes, low wooden stools, a small kitchen with a gas stove behind, a steep tiled staircase, a family altar shelf with incense, warm tungsten light.
clips.sfx: incense crackling, a small brass bell ringing once, a tie sliding loose, heavy footsteps on tiles

shots.camera: 50mm medium shot of the son striding in through the doorway, locked off
85mm close-up of the old mother's face lit by a small flame at the altar, locked off

steps: In the family's narrow tube house in warm tungsten light, @Tung strides in through the doorway loosening his tie and is already speaking fast and irritably, while @BaNhan sits on a low stool beside the family altar with her back to the room, mouth closed.
@Tung keeps talking, tossing his car keys onto the round dining table.
@Tung keeps going, flinging one hand toward the street door.
@Tung keeps speaking, standing over the table with his hands on his hips.
@Tung finishes and closes his mouth, waiting.
@BaNhan, without turning round, begins to answer slowly and heavily, lighting a stick of incense.
@BaNhan keeps speaking, her face lit by the small flame, her eyes on the old framed photos.
@BaNhan keeps talking, never turning to her son.
@BaNhan keeps going, her voice low, the incense smoke rising past her face.
@BaNhan keeps speaking, her wrinkled lips barely moving, her eyes half closed.
@BaNhan sets the incense in the bowl and closes her mouth; @Tung snaps back with a sharp retort, his jaw tight.
@Tung keeps talking sharply, rubbing his face with one hand.
@Tung keeps going, jabbing a thumb at his own chest.
@Tung finishes and closes his mouth.
@Tung turns away toward the steep staircase, while @BaNhan stays bowed before the altar, both silent.

scenes.title: Đám Hỏi Bắt Đầu
scenes.time_label: Tối, sảnh tiệc khách sạn (15:00–16:00)
scenes.location: Sảnh tiệc khách sạn trang hoàng cho lễ ăn hỏi, buổi tối.
scenes.axis: Máy đặt giữa lối đi nhìn lên sân khấu: cổng hoa ở giữa, bàn tròn hai bên, bàn khay sính lễ bên phải sân khấu, cửa lớn sau lưng máy; 16.3 máy đặt ngang lối đi, cửa lớn bên phải khung hình, sân khấu bên trái.
scenes.props: Cổng hoa, phông trái tim vàng không chữ, khay sính lễ phủ khăn đỏ, cặp tài liệu da đen với giấy sang tên (không chữ), bút ký, hộp quà đỏ lớn thắt nơ vàng, tạp dề và thước dây vàng của Thu.
scenes.setting: A lavish hotel banquet hall set for an engagement ceremony in the evening: round tables with white cloths and red roses, a low stage with a flower arch and a gold heart backdrop with no letters, trays of betrothal gifts covered in red cloth, crystal chandeliers, warm golden light.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Kính thưa các cụ, các bác! Cảm ơn mọi người đến chung vui với gia đình tôi trong ngày trọng đại này!

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Em cảm ơn anh. Cả đời này em chỉ làm vợ anh thôi, anh nhớ nhé.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Xin mời nhà gái nhận lễ! Trầu cau, rượu chè đủ cả rồi!

wardrobe.@Vy: a red silk wedding áo dài embroidered with a gold phoenix, a matching red khăn vấn headband, a thin gold necklace, beige high heels

clips.extras: a stiff middle-aged couple in formal clothes at the front table and a few engagement guests, far in the background and out of focus
clips.sfx: a ripple of polite applause, glasses clinking, a microphone hum, high heels on the stage boards

steps: Under a flower arch on the low stage of the chandelier-lit banquet hall, @Tung stands beside @Vy, sweeps one arm toward the hall and is already speaking fast and proudly, while @Vy smiles beside him with her mouth closed.
@Tung keeps talking, booming, his chest puffed out.
@Tung keeps going, bowing his head toward the far tables, where a few guests sit far away, blurred and out of focus.
@Tung keeps speaking grandly, one hand on his heart.
@Tung keeps talking, beaming at the hall.
@Tung closes his mouth; @Vy turns to him, lowers her eyes and answers slowly and sweetly.
@Vy keeps speaking softly, her hands folded at her waist, her red khăn vấn glowing in the chandelier light.
@Vy keeps talking, lifting her eyes to him with a demure smile.
@Vy keeps going, a hidden smirk tugging at one corner of her mouth.
@Vy keeps speaking, her smile hardening at the corners.
@Vy closes her mouth, glancing toward the blurred front table far behind; @Tung gestures grandly at the trays of betrothal gifts under red cloth and calls out a ceremonial line.
@Tung keeps talking, booming, his arm stretched toward the trays.
@Tung keeps going, grinning at the guests.
@Tung finishes and closes his mouth, beaming at the hall.
@Tung stands proudly under the flower arch, his hand still raised toward the trays, while @Vy keeps her demure pose beside him, both silent.

turns.speaker: @Khai
turns.line: Anh Tùng, giấy sang tên nhà đây. Chỉ thiếu mỗi chữ ký của chị Thu nữa thôi.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Sắp đến rồi. Cô ấy hứa ký ngay tại đây, trước bao nhiêu khách. Cô ấy chưa sai hẹn bao giờ.

turns.speaker: @Khai
turns.line: Bút em mở nắp sẵn rồi, chị ấy đến là ký được ngay.

steps: Beside a long white-clothed table of betrothal gift trays under red cloth, @Khai opens a black leather document folder the right way up and is already speaking smoothly to @Tung, who adjusts his cufflinks with his mouth closed.
@Khai keeps talking, businesslike, showing him papers with no readable writing.
@Khai keeps going, running a finger down to a blank space at the bottom of the page.
@Khai keeps speaking, tapping the blank space twice.
@Khai finishes and closes his mouth, holding the folder open.
@Tung glances toward the tall doors at the far end of the hall and answers fast and impatiently.
@Tung keeps talking, tapping his gold wristwatch.
@Tung keeps going, rising onto his toes to look over the tables.
@Tung keeps speaking, nodding firmly to himself.
@Tung finishes and closes his mouth, his eyes still on the doors.

@Khai keeps talking, holding the uncapped pen up between two fingers.
@Khai keeps going, a sly half-smile spreading under his thin moustache.

@Khai smooths his thin moustache with a sly half-smile, while @Tung keeps watching the doors, mouth closed.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Chị đến thật đấy à? Đeo cả tạp dề đi ăn hỏi, đúng là bà thợ may. Khách khứa cười cho đấy.

turns.speaker: @Vy
turns.line: Quà gì? Em không nhận đâu! Chị mang về mà dùng.

steps: At the foot of the flower-arched stage, @Vy turns toward the center aisle and is already speaking with a mocking smile, as @Thu walks up the aisle in her dark-green apron with the yellow measuring tape around her neck, carrying a large red gift box with a gold ribbon bow, mouth closed.
@Vy keeps talking, eyebrows raised, eyeing the apron up and down.
@Vy keeps going, folding her arms with a little laugh.
@Vy keeps speaking, flicking a glance at the guests' tables.
@Vy finishes and closes her mouth, arms folded, as @Thu stops a step away from her.
@Thu answers slowly and pleasantly, holding the red box in front of her.
@Thu keeps speaking, unhurried, with a small polite smile.
@Thu keeps talking, nodding at the red wedding áo dài the bride is wearing.
@Thu keeps going, glancing down at the gold bow on the red box.
@Thu keeps speaking, lifting the red box slightly toward the bride.
@Thu keeps talking, her small polite smile unchanged.
@Thu closes her mouth; @Vy's eyes narrow at the red box and she answers with a quick sharp refusal.
@Vy keeps talking sharply, waving the box away without touching it.
@Vy keeps going, then finishes and closes her mouth, tightening her folded arms.

turns.line: Tiền mồ hôi nên bánh ngọt hơn hẳn mọi năm đấy. Vào đi con.

steps: @BaNhan in her purple áo dài peers toward the open front door and is already speaking in a slow mock-stern voice, leaning on her stick.
@BaNhan keeps speaking, squinting with exaggerated suspicion.
@BaNhan keeps talking slowly, waving her stick at the doorway.
@BaNhan goes on, eyebrows raised high.
@BaNhan finishes and closes her mouth, waiting.
@Tung, standing on the threshold in his charcoal suit with his face tanned dark from the site and a cake box in both arms, starts answering shyly.
@Tung keeps speaking, a boyish smile spreading.
@Tung keeps talking and lifts the cake box toward her like a schoolboy with a prize.
@Tung keeps speaking proudly, his ears going pink.
@Tung finishes and closes his mouth, still holding the box out.
@BaNhan answers in a dry teasing voice, tapping the box lid with one finger.
@BaNhan keeps talking, her eyes twinkling.
@BaNhan keeps speaking, beckoning him inside with her stick.

@Tung ducks his head with a sheepish grin and steps over the threshold, mouth closed, while @BaNhan holds the cake box to her chest.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Ghế của anh cạnh cái Na, con nó để phần từ chiều, ai hỏi cũng không nhường.

turns.speaker: @Tung
turns.line: Cảm ơn em cho anh về ăn bữa cơm này. Anh cứ sợ em không cho anh vào.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Anh về vì mẹ với con. Còn bữa cơm, em nấu cho người nhà.

steps: @Thu lights a match, touches it to the first thin candle on the cream birthday cake and is already speaking in a practical, even voice.
@Thu keeps talking, lighting the candles one by one.
@Thu keeps speaking, nodding toward an empty chair at the round table.
@Thu goes on, shaking out the match and lighting another.
@Thu finishes and closes her mouth, the flame creeping down the match.
@Tung, standing at the edge of the table with his hands folded, starts answering quietly with his eyes lowered.
@Tung keeps speaking humbly, his voice thick.
@Tung keeps talking, glancing at the warm room around him.
@Tung goes on, his eyes lifting to her for a moment.
@Tung finishes and closes his mouth, looking down again.
@Thu answers slowly and calmly, looking straight at @Tung across the cake.
@Thu keeps speaking evenly, the candle flames trembling between them.
@Thu keeps talking, kind but clear, while @Tung listens with his mouth closed.

scenes.title: Đo Lòng Người
scenes.time_label: Một năm sau, tiệm may hai tầng lúc bình minh (24:00–25:00)
scenes.location: Tiệm may áo dài của Thu trên phố Hàng Gai, nay đã mở rộng thành hai tầng, lúc bình minh, một năm sau.
scenes.axis: Máy quay đặt cạnh kệ lụa mới nhìn ra cửa kính: ba máy may dọc tường bên trái, gương thử rộng bên phải, ma-nơ-canh mặc áo dài hoàn chỉnh cạnh cửa sổ, cầu thang gỗ lên tầng hai phía sau bên phải, bàn cắt ở giữa.
scenes.props: Thước dây vàng, tờ báo không chữ đọc được, ba máy may, ma-nơ-canh mặc áo dài hoàn chỉnh, gương thử rộng, chuông đồng trên cửa, khăn quàng đỏ và cặp sách của Na, kim chỉ.
scenes.setting: One year later at dawn, Thu's áo dài tailor shop now spread over two floors on the old-quarter silk street: new wooden shelves of jewel-toned silk, three sewing machines, dress forms in finished áo dài by the window, a wide fitting mirror, a small brass bell above the glass door, warm morning light.

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Mới một năm mà tiệm lên hai tầng, khách đặt may xếp lịch đến tận Tết rồi đấy.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Nhờ mẹ giữ cho con một đường lui, con mới dám bước tiếp, mẹ ạ.

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Thôi, khen nhau đủ rồi, mở cửa đi con, kẻo khách mở hàng lại sang tiệm khác!

steps: @BaNhan comes down the wooden staircase with her bamboo walking stick, waving it proudly at the full shelves of silk, and is already speaking fast and bright.
@BaNhan keeps talking proudly as she reaches the bottom step, pointing her stick up toward the second floor.
@BaNhan keeps speaking, her wrinkled face beaming.
@BaNhan goes on, gesturing at the three sewing machines in a row.
@BaNhan finishes and closes her mouth, and @Thu, in an elegant ivory silk áo dài, steps out from between the tall shelves with a fresh bolt of silk in her arms and starts answering slowly and warmly.
@Thu keeps speaking warmly, her hand resting on the yellow tailor's measuring tape around her neck.
@Thu keeps talking softly, her eyes shining.
@Thu keeps speaking, a grateful smile at the corner of her mouth.
@Thu goes on to the last words, looking at her mother-in-law.
@Thu closes her mouth, and @BaNhan flaps a hand and starts answering fast, brushing it all off.
@BaNhan keeps talking briskly, waving her stick toward the glass door.
@BaNhan keeps speaking, shooing @Thu toward the door with one hand.
@BaNhan keeps talking, peering out at the street through the glass.

wardrobe.@Thu: an elegant ivory silk áo dài of her own design, a yellow tailor's measuring tape around her neck, low beige sandals

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Báo đăng hai đứa lừa đảo ấy lĩnh án rồi đây này. Đấy, cái kết cho tiểu tam!

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Mẹ đọc khẽ thôi, cái Na nghe thấy lại hỏi đấy. Con bé đang soạn cặp trên gác.

turns.speaker: @BaNhan
turns.line: Ừ nhỉ. Mẹ gấp lại đây, mẹ chưa nói gì nhé.

steps: @BaNhan sits on a stool by the cutting table, unfolds a newspaper with no readable writing at arm's length and is already speaking in a smug gossipy voice, while @Thu stands beside her with her mouth closed.
@BaNhan keeps talking, peering over the top of the page, while @Thu threads a needle.
@BaNhan keeps speaking with relish, tapping the newspaper with one bony finger.
@BaNhan keeps talking, her voice rising with satisfaction.
@BaNhan goes on with a triumphant nod.
@BaNhan closes her mouth, and @Thu glances toward the staircase and starts answering slowly in a hushed voice, lowering one hand in a gentle hushing gesture.
@Thu keeps speaking softly, one finger raised toward the second floor.
@Thu keeps whispering gently, her eyes on the stairs.
@Thu keeps speaking in a hushed voice.
@Thu goes on softly, pointing up at the ceiling.
@Thu finishes the warning and closes her mouth.
@BaNhan answers in a quick sheepish whisper, folding the newspaper in half.

turns.speaker: @Na
turns.line: Mẹ ơi, tiểu tam là gì ạ? Có phải là mẹ hai không? Con nghe bà đọc to lắm.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Tiểu tam là người đi đặt may áo cưới nhầm tiệm, con ạ.

turns.speaker: @Na
turns.line: Ơ, nhưng tiệm mình may đẹp nhất phố mà mẹ! Sao lại nhầm được ạ?

steps: @Na comes down the last wooden stairs in her school uniform, stops in front of @Thu, who kneels to straighten the red scarf at her neck, and is already asking in a curious earnest voice, head tilted.

@Na keeps speaking earnestly, twisting one pigtail around her finger.

@Na keeps talking, lowering her voice as if sharing a secret.
@Na finishes and closes her mouth, and @Thu finishes knotting the red scarf and starts answering slowly with a gentle smile.

@Thu keeps talking gently, her eyes crinkling.
@Thu keeps speaking, with a tiny nod.

@Thu, still kneeling, smiles at her daughter and smooths her pigtails in silence, mouth closed.

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Vì khách nào mẹ cũng đo rất kỹ mà. Chỗ nào khách giấu, thước của mẹ cũng thấy.

turns.speaker: @Na
turns.line: Vai, eo mẹ đều đo được. Thế lòng người thì mẹ có đo được không ạ?

turns.speaker: @Thu
turns.line: Đo được con ạ. Người thật lòng thì số đo không bao giờ thay đổi.
